# CanopyChat

> CanopyChat makes a private AI chat app for iPhone, Android and computers, and Canopy Code, a terminal coding agent for developers. Not related to Canopy the humidifier and shower filter brand.

Every page has a plain Markdown version: add .md to the address (for example https://canopychat.app/canopy-code.md, https://canopychat.app/blog/run-ai-models-locally.md, https://canopychat.app/index.md for the home page).

## Canopy Code

- [Canopy Code](https://canopychat.app/canopy-code): The terminal coding agent from CanopyChat. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, API keys and local models (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp); switch models mid-session; control it from the CanopyChat app on iPhone. Runs on macOS (Apple silicon), Linux and Windows. Install: `brew install nathanaelguitar/canopy/canopy-code` (macOS, Linux) or Scoop (Windows).
- [Canopy Code: a terminal coding agent for any model, now in VS Code](https://canopychat.app/blog/canopy-code-terminal-coding-agent): Overview and release 2026.11.05 notes, including the VS Code extension.
- [What Is an AI Coding Agent, and How Is It Different From Autocomplete?](https://canopychat.app/blog/what-is-an-ai-coding-agent): An AI coding agent reads your project, edits files and runs commands to finish a task. Here is how it differs from autocomplete and chat, and what to check before you trust one.
- [Can You Run AI on Your Own Computer? A Plain Guide to Local Models](https://canopychat.app/blog/run-ai-models-locally): Local AI models run on your own hardware, so your prompts stay on your machine. What they are good at, what hardware you need, and the tools to start with.
- [Private AI Chat You Can Trust: How CanopyChat Protects Your Data](https://canopychat.app/blog/private-ai-chat-what-on-device-means): CanopyChat answers on your device first, and every cloud feature is opt in. Here is how your data is protected, from on-device chat to zero data retention in the cloud.
- [CanopyChat, Canopy Code and Flame: What Each One Does](https://canopychat.app/blog/canopychat-canopy-code-and-flame): A plain guide to the Canopy family: CanopyChat for private AI chat, Canopy Code for coding in the terminal, and Flame, the agent that keeps working in the cloud.
- [Releases](https://github.com/nathanaelguitar/canopy-code/releases): Binaries and checksums.
